items.organizationName: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Industrial Control Systems (ICS)
items.scope: Vulnerabilities that are (1) reported to or observed by CISA, (2) affect industrial control systems or medical devices, and (3) are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities for OTRS and ((OTRS)) Community Edition and modules only.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Forcepoint products only.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
Solidigm branded products and technologies.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Johnson Controls products only.
Vulnerabilities discovered in the services and applications of the MeetMe and DuoxMe products that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Lexmark products only.
Microchip Technology products only.
All products of 2N Telekomunikace a.s. including end-of-life/end-of-service products.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Synaptics issues only.
Software vulnerabilities related to the TianoCore Open Source.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
Zyxel products issues only.
ASR products only.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Pegasystems products only.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Radiometer products only.
Synology issues only.
Vulnerabilities in runZero products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, runZero that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
Crafter CMS issues only.
Kaspersky B2C and B2B products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered in third-party software not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in software discovered by National Cyber Security Centre SK-CERT, and vulnerabilities reported to National Cyber Security Centre SK-CERT for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects listed on its Alibaba GitHub website only.
NEC issues only.
openHarmony issues only.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.

Vulnerabilities in Delinea products or services listed on delinea.com, or vulnerabilities in third-party products or services discovered by or reported to Delinea, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SBA Research or reported to SBA Research by partner organizations that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in software, services, and infrastructure owned and managed by Spartans Security, and vulnerabilities researched and found by Spartans Security in third-party products that are not part of another CNA's scope.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All SAP products.
